title: 汇丰郭美雪：北都供应过剩，30万人才流入能化解？
speaker: Michelle Kwok

segments.en: IP protection we bring in global capital and. Shenzhen on the other hand is about manufacturing engineering commercialization etc
segments.zh: 知识产权保护，我们引入全球资本。而深圳则侧重制造、工程、商业化等

segments.en: So we basically have to find a midpoint how we are able to create synergies together. Hong Kong and Shenzhen not here to compete with shenzhen not here to compare ourselves with shenzhen
segments.zh: 所以我们必须找到中点，如何共同创造协同效应。香港和深圳不是来与深圳竞争，不是来与深圳比较

segments.en: Should we be concerned about oversupply? I mean just given the numbers how big this is. You know obviously we've seen urban development of the scale before
segments.zh: 我们该担心供应过剩吗？考虑到规模之大。显然我们见过这种规模的城市开发

segments.en: In countries like Saudi Arabia with Neon with Indonesia's new Santara and then that's talked about delays and. You know debt issues and the like mean should we be concerned about. oversupply
segments.zh: 像沙特NEOM、印尼新首都，都谈到延期和债务压力。我们该担心供应过剩吗？

segments.en: So delays are probably something that we just have to work with just part of the expectation. oversupply perhaps in terms of housing I think. If this area is able to really house and draw in people from across the border
segments.zh: 延期可能是我们必须接受的预期一部分。供应过剩或许在住宅方面，如果该区域真能容纳并吸引跨境人口

segments.en: I think we should then think a little bit about how we can complement and. Mobilize existing residents in Hong Kong maybe part of it we have to be out of elderly
segments.zh: 我认为我们应思考如何补充和调动香港现有居民，也许一部分是年长者

segments.en: Population and a part of it would be the younger generation actually coming through from shenzhen into Hong Kong. So to just give you a number to contextualize. I think the government has already brought in around 300,000 people
segments.zh: 另一部分是年轻一代从深圳来到香港。给你一个数字作背景，政府已引入约30万人

segments.en: Through various top talent scheme and actually 70% of them are h below 40. So if you're able to think about how we can bring in younger generation into Hong Kong that would drive put activity and oversupply issue with them resolve itself
segments.zh: 通过各种高端人才计划，其中70%在40岁以下。如果能引入年轻一代到香港，将带动活动，供应过剩问题也会随之化解
